name: v1.33.0
body:
## What's Changed
* ci: move macOS jobs to macos-15 and actions to Node 24 by @jterpstra1 in https://github.com/icloud-photos-downloader/icloud_photos_downloader/pull/1395
* fix(deps): bump certifi to 2026.10.23 for GHSA-6q48-6c7w-9gw2 by @jterpstra1 in https://github.com/icloud-photos-downloader/icloud_photos_downloader/pull/1396
* feat: support Python 3.14, drop 3.10 by @jterpstra1 in https://github.com/icloud-photos-downloader/icloud_photos_downloader/pull/1397
* ci: cancel superseded runs, add job timeouts, generate test locales instead of installing locales-all by @jterpstra1 in https://github.com/icloud-photos-downloader/icloud_photos_downloader/pull/1398
* fix: warn instead of crashing when --use-os-locale can't use the system locale by @jterpstra1 in https://github.com/icloud-photos-downloader/icloud_photos_downloader/pull/1401
* ci: run the npm/npx compatibility tests for Arm on Arm runners by @jterpstra1 in https://github.com/icloud-photos-downloader/icloud_photos_downloader/pull/1402
* ci: batch the Linux compatibility tests (376 → 73 jobs), move to ubuntu-24.04 by @jterpstra1 in https://github.com/icloud-photos-downloader/icloud_photos_downloader/pull/1399
* fix: only delete from iCloud with --keep-icloud-recent-days when the photo is present locally by @jterpstra1 in https://github.com/icloud-photos-downloader/icloud_photos_downloader/pull/1403
* build(deps): update dependencies, including urllib3 2 by @jterpstra1 in https://github.com/icloud-photos-downloader/icloud_photos_downloader/pull/1404
* fix: don't let undecodable XMP metadata stop the download run by @jterpstra1 in https://github.com/icloud-photos-downloader/icloud_photos_downloader/pull/1405
* fix: skip a locked or unavailable keyring instead of crashing login by @jterpstra1 in https://github.com/icloud-photos-downloader/icloud_photos_downloader/pull/1406
* build: support Python 3.15 and build binaries and Docker images with it by @jterpstra1 in https://github.com/icloud-photos-downloader/icloud_photos_downloader/pull/1407
* Report a login error instead of KeyError: 'dsInfo' when the session is invalid by @Kernel-Hunter in https://github.com/icloud-photos-downloader/icloud_photos_downloader/pull/1382
* fix: retry library indexing state check before failing (#1387) by @sithikaf in https://github.com/icloud-photos-downloader/icloud_photos_downloader/pull/1388
* feat: add --adp-web-access for Advanced Data Protection accounts by @Mehdi-Leqsiouer in https://github.com/icloud-photos-downloader/icloud_photos_downloader/pull/1392
* fix: yield every asset when several share one master by @helinwang in https://github.com/icloud-photos-downloader/icloud_photos_downloader/pull/1394
* fix: warn when iCloud never confirms ADP web access, list --adp-web-access as experimental by @jterpstra1 in https://github.com/icloud-photos-downloader/icloud_photos_downloader/pull/1408
* test: cover skipping an asset whose master record is missing by @jterpstra1 in https://github.com/icloud-photos-downloader/icloud_photos_downloader/pull/1409
* fix: warn when --keep-icloud-recent-days is combined with --recent or --until-found by @jterpstra1 in https://github.com/icloud-photos-downloader/icloud_photos_downloader/pull/1410
* fix: include time zone data so icloud/icloudpd run without a system tz database by @jterpstra1 in https://github.com/icloud-photos-downloader/icloud_photos_downloader/pull/1411
* docs: document the Linux binary variants and the Alpine 3.20+ minimum for musl by @jterpstra1 in https://github.com/icloud-photos-downloader/icloud_photos_downloader/pull/1412
* ci: fix false failures in the compatibility report, add tzlc table to notes by @jterpstra1 in https://github.com/icloud-photos-downloader/icloud_photos_downloader/pull/1413
* fix: build the macOS binaries for Intel and Apple Silicon by @jterpstra1 in https://github.com/icloud-photos-downloader/icloud_photos_downloader/pull/1414
* fix: treat JPEG XL and other unknown image types as photos, not videos by @jterpstra1 in https://github.com/icloud-photos-downloader/icloud_photos_downloader/pull/1415
* fix: don't crash the icloud tool on a locked or unavailable keyring by @jterpstra1 in https://github.com/icloud-photos-downloader/icloud_photos_downloader/pull/1416
* Propagate exit code from the icloudpd executable by @Kernel-Hunter in https://github.com/icloud-photos-downloader/icloud_photos_downloader/pull/1380
* Reject --skip-created-before later than --skip-created-after by @Kernel-Hunter in https://github.com/icloud-photos-downloader/icloud_photos_downloader/pull/1381
* fix: trigger the 2FA push in the icloud tool by @jterpstra1 in https://github.com/icloud-photos-downloader/icloud_photos_downloader/pull/1417
* fix: RFC 5322 Date header in the 2FA expiry email by @jterpstra1 in https://github.com/icloud-photos-downloader/icloud_photos_downloader/pull/1418
* fix: --auto-delete uses the file match policy and filename cleaner by @jterpstra1 in https://github.com/icloud-photos-downloader/icloud_photos_downloader/pull/1421
* fix: keep the name-id7 suffix on adjusted and alternative files by @jterpstra1 in https://github.com/icloud-photos-downloader/icloud_photos_downloader/pull/1419
* Skip XMP sidecars when only printing filenames by @victorwon2001 in https://github.com/icloud-photos-downloader/icloud_photos_downloader/pull/1374
* feat: sign in with a security key (FIDO) by @spinnerich in https://github.com/icloud-photos-downloader/icloud_photos_downloader/pull/1423
* fix: consistent time zone for --skip-created-*, and tests that pass in any time zone by @jterpstra1 in https://github.com/icloud-photos-downloader/icloud_photos_downloader/pull/1424
* docs: describe each --size and update the TrueNAS steps for 25.10 by @jterpstra1 in https://github.com/icloud-photos-downloader/icloud_photos_downloader/pull/1426
* build(deps-dev): bump mypy from 2.4.0 to 2.4.1 by @dependabot[bot] in https://github.com/icloud-photos-downloader/icloud_photos_downloader/pull/1430
* feat: add --prune-orphans flag to clean local files for photos removed from shared library by @samaluk in https://github.com/icloud-photos-downloader/icloud_photos_downloader/pull/1351
* fix: reject --auto-delete together with --keep-icloud-recent-days by @jterpstra1 in https://github.com/icloud-photos-downloader/icloud_photos_downloader/pull/1427
* fix: --keep-icloud-recent-days keeps assets without a creation date by @jterpstra1 in https://github.com/icloud-photos-downloader/icloud_photos_downloader/pull/1429
* fix: --set-exif-datetime skips JPEGs with malformed EXIF instead of crashing by @jterpstra1 in https://github.com/icloud-photos-downloader/icloud_photos_downloader/pull/1432
* fix: list albums beyond the first page of iCloud's album list by @jterpstra1 in https://github.com/icloud-photos-downloader/icloud_photos_downloader/pull/1434
* fix: resume downloads after a dropped connection and check the size before saving by @jterpstra1 in https://github.com/icloud-photos-downloader/icloud_photos_downloader/pull/1436
* feat: adopt existing dedicated shared-library mirrors by @samaluk in https://github.com/icloud-photos-downloader/icloud_photos_downloader/pull/1433
* fix: create missing parent folders of --cookie-directory by @jterpstra1 in https://github.com/icloud-photos-downloader/icloud_photos_downloader/pull/1438
* ci: test current distributions, drop end-of-life ones by @jterpstra1 in https://github.com/icloud-photos-downloader/icloud_photos_downloader/pull/1439
* feat: list and download albums in folders by @jterpstra1 in https://github.com/icloud-photos-downloader/icloud_photos_downloader/pull/1440
* docs: cron example uses --directory and the keyring instead of --password by @jterpstra1 in https://github.com/icloud-photos-downloader/icloud_photos_downloader/pull/1437
* fix: skip a file instead of ending the run when iCloud can't be reached by @jterpstra1 in https://github.com/icloud-photos-downloader/icloud_photos_downloader/pull/1441
* fix: write the EXIF DateTime tag in the main IFD by @jterpstra1 in https://github.com/icloud-photos-downloader/icloud_photos_downloader/pull/1442
* fix: don't download a photo again after --set-exif-datetime changed it by @jterpstra1 in https://github.com/icloud-photos-downloader/icloud_photos_downloader/pull/1443
* fix: report a photo listing that ended early instead of success by @jterpstra1 in https://github.com/icloud-photos-downloader/icloud_photos_downloader/pull/1444
* fix: --live-photo-size thumb crashed at startup by @jterpstra1 in https://github.com/icloud-photos-downloader/icloud_photos_downloader/pull/1449
* docs: fix wrong and outdated statements by @jterpstra1 in https://github.com/icloud-photos-downloader/icloud_photos_downloader/pull/1450
* Keep going when iCloud refuses a delete with TRY_AGAIN_LATER by @Kernel-Hunter in https://github.com/icloud-photos-downloader/icloud_photos_downloader/pull/1447
* Web UI: keep configuration panels open across status refreshes by @Kernel-Hunter in https://github.com/icloud-photos-downloader/icloud_photos_downloader/pull/1448
* Bump to 1.33.0 by @jterpstra1 in https://github.com/icloud-photos-downloader/icloud_photos_downloader/pull/1452

## New Contributors
* @jterpstra1 made their first contribution in https://github.com/icloud-photos-downloader/icloud_photos_downloader/pull/1395
* @Kernel-Hunter made their first contribution in https://github.com/icloud-photos-downloader/icloud_photos_downloader/pull/1382
* @sithikaf made their first contribution in https://github.com/icloud-photos-downloader/icloud_photos_downloader/pull/1388
* @Mehdi-Leqsiouer made their first contribution in https://github.com/icloud-photos-downloader/icloud_photos_downloader/pull/1392
* @helinwang made their first contribution in https://github.com/icloud-photos-downloader/icloud_photos_downloader/pull/1394
* @victorwon2001 made their first contribution in https://github.com/icloud-photos-downloader/icloud_photos_downloader/pull/1374
* @spinnerich made their first contribution in https://github.com/icloud-photos-downloader/icloud_photos_downloader/pull/1423
* @samaluk made their first contribution in https://github.com/icloud-photos-downloader/icloud_photos_downloader/pull/1351

**Full Changelog**: https://github.com/icloud-photos-downloader/icloud_photos_downloader/compare/v1.32.3...v1.33.0
